ru: При необходи́мости мы да́ли бы вам ещё оди́н день.
en: If necessary, we would give you one more day.
en_alt: If it had been necessary, we would have given you one more day.
note: бы + past is ambiguous between a present and a past counterfactual; nothing here anchors it in past time, so the present reading leads and the past reading is an accepted alternate.

en: You should pay attention to this.

note: «Ты бы + past» with no conditional phrase is advisory, not counterfactual — it is a suggestion, and "you would have …" is not what the Russian says.

ru: Ты бы определи́л срок то́чно.
en: You should set an exact deadline.
en_alt: You should set the deadline precisely.
You should determine the deadline precisely.
note: Advisory «Ты бы + past». Both earlier renderings put the adverb on the verb, which is stiff in English; the adjective on the noun is how this is said. The gloss-aligned "determine" stays accepted.
